agreement.scope: pairwise equality and Fleiss kappa over 3 annotators; same-model process independence only, not human kappa or accuracy

legacy_audit.note: legacy v4 GT and author metadata are read-only provenance; mismatches are expected when blind evidence contradicts author intent

assumptions: same model/provider/configuration as the smoke run
base per-session context ~2500 fresh + ~5400 cached tokens (measured with the neutral-cwd probe)
adjudication share inherited from the previous round (9/93) as a conservative planning value
wall clock assumes 3 annotator sessions per batch in parallel and one sequential adjudicator session per disputed batch
batch_size 1 is recommended for the full run: observed near-cap output truncation on single-case sessions makes multi-case batches risky; override with --batch-size if output limits are raised

worker.fresh_session_mechanism: one new subprocess per session; --session-id is never passed
